$comment: The chrome is the Prototemplate viewer shell ported as source (SPEC 2.2). Every file under src records its origin in /Users/kevinliu/repos/Prototemplate at the commit that last touched the source file (git log -1 -- <path>), read on 2026-09-10 at HEAD 0594fa19a56266195b68aa13de14e4c01c87941b. `changes` lists every edit beyond import paths and the @/ alias; a file with an empty list is verbatim apart from those. Shared across every port: `useGSAP` (a layout effect with dependencies) became React's useLayoutEffect, `@/lib/use-mount-effect` became src/lib/useMountEffect.ts, `@/lib/cn` became src/lib/cn.ts, and the double-quoted JSX attributes follow the repo's Prettier config.

changes: the four site colors (--pt-site-dossier, --pt-site-orbit, --pt-site-signal, --pt-site-shipped) and their dark remap removed (SPEC 2.2: verbatim minus the four site colors)
--pt-display and --pt-text drop Next's var(--font-inter): Inter comes from @turboslide/fonts, and an undefined custom property would invalidate the whole font-family declaration
the site map fields (href, url, surface, inPlace, under) removed; previewId() returns the item id
ShellItem gains kind, html, lint and leased for the sidebar rows of SPEC 6.2 and the live clones of M1
ShellMark is 'gt' only
two optional flags, panel and search, say whether the route offers the index panel and the search palette
only the names Turboslide's chrome draws are kept (22 of 37); the paths are verbatim
a `control` prop writes data-control for the window API (SPEC 6.5)
a `control` prop prefixes data-control on the options
the Search pill (Palette, M3) and the Index button (no index panel in Turboslide yet) removed; tier four collapses Help, Present and the slot
the brand is the GT mark only (no PtMark, no mark prop)
the seg's slide label reads Slide (the deck's word) rather than Slides
data-control ids on every button

M3: the Search pill returns as SearchPill behind an `onSearch` prop (the palette opener, SPEC 6.3) with `searchOpen` for its ink frame; a `status` slot left of it takes the StatusChip (SPEC 6.1); EditTools (the Edit | View Seg, Twin, Lint with its count badge, Source) is exported for the route to place in the slot
the .pt-search-btn and .pt-search-kbd rules and the html[data-shell-sb] boot stamp rules removed with the controls they styled
M3: the .pt-search-btn and .pt-search-kbd rules restored from the source with the palette, plus the tier-four and narrow rules for the pill; .pt-bar-status and .pt-lint-count are new
the site map (surfaces, NAV_GROUPS, buildGroups, merge, nesting, Next Link and router) removed: groups are the deck's sections, rows are slides

rows carry the derived number, a kind glyph from the theme sprite, the lint badge and the lease dot (SPEC 6.2); thumbnail density draws a 64 by 36 live clone through @turboslide/viewer LiveClone, with ThumbShot for static twins
the filter matches title, section, id and the slide's text (SPEC 6.2)
folds persist under gt-shell-groups:<id> and every section is open by default
ThumbList moved to @turboslide/viewer GridView

M3 (SPEC 6.2): an `edit` prop turns on drag to reorder within and across sections (one slide.move on drop, a header drop inserts first), Alt with the up and down arrows to move a focused row, empty sections listed as drop targets, and the row menu (Insert after, Duplicate, Move to section, Render, Lint this slide, Copy id, Delete), every item one action through the dispatcher
the site map rules (data-site colors, child groups, the nameplate faces) removed; the list is .pt-tree (the grid's .pt-thumbs rules moved to @turboslide/viewer GridView.css)
rows gain a 22px number column, .pt-orow-marks for the badge and the lease dot, and .pt-orow-kind for the second line in thumbnail density
M3: the drop line (2px ink, a state), the dragging row, the empty-section note, the row menu button and the menu card
the row carries data-preview
the input carries data-control="sidebar.filter"
the Sidebar.css side-effect import moved to Sidebar.tsx

the subject is a live clone of the slide's HTML (a `resolve` prop) instead of a decoded capture from src/lib/surfaces.ts; the image cache, the preload observers, the theme MutationObserver and the crossfade of captures are gone until the render worker's thumbnails return in M3
the mechanics (delegated listeners, 80ms arm, 120ms grace, the eased move, the scroll follow, the close conditions) are kept
the .pt-preview-img and .is-solo rules (captures) removed; the width and height transitions of .is-moving removed
the phone fallback for --pt-toolbar-h is 52px (the toolbar stays one row)
the .pt-panel exclusion in the scroll listener removed with the index panel

readTheme, applyTheme, toggleTheme, postTheme and the Theme type moved to @turboslide/viewer/theme, which writes the deck's dual key (gt-theme then gt-deck-theme, SPEC 6.8) and swaps the sheet's twins
the Safari re-assertion of the attribute is dropped (the studio's boot script is the only writer before hydration)
Cmd K opens the palette through an `openSearch` option and only when ShellState.search is set; R toggles the index only when ShellState.panel is set; the help rows follow the same flags
the index panel, the site map and the surfaces set removed
the hash is read and written through @turboslide/viewer/hash in the form the `hash` prop names (#NN for the embed, #s/<slideId> for the studio; SPEC 5.3)
`initialMode` (the route's ?mode=) takes precedence over the saved mode and `onModeChange` reports every change; `onSelect` receives the item's 1-based number
the html[data-shell-sb] boot stamp is not written (the studio's boot script stamps the theme only)
the root carries data-mode, data-active, data-index and data-total for the window API and the Playwright specs
the preview layer resolves subjects from the items' HTML

M3 (SPEC 6.1): `onSearch` (sets the shell search flag and Cmd K), `searchOpen`, `toolbarStatus`, `panel` (the inspector in the main region's second column), `drawer` (the source drawer over the stage) and `sidebarEdit` props; the main region carries data-panel while an inspector is present
the html[data-shell-sb] and html[data-shell-density] boot rules removed; .pt-thumbs became .pt-tree in the density fade; the .sheet-flow rules removed

M3: the two-column main region under data-panel (the toolbar spans both, the inspector takes rows two and three and owns the seam with its left edge), the drawer's right edge at the panel, present and narrow rules for both

grown into the command palette of SPEC 6.3: the entries come in as props (palette-data.ts builds the five groups from the document and the action table) and Enter runs an entry through the editor dispatcher, a prompt entry after one field, a view toggle through its callback; the router, the site index and the anchor rows are gone
the trigger pill moved to Toolbar.tsx (SearchPill) and the open state to the route; useShellKeys opens it through ViewerShell onSearch instead of a document event
rows gain a key chip and a hint line; group labels carry their prefix chip; the foot names the three prefixes
the site-color rules (data-site) removed with the site map; the field takes the shell corner like the sidebar filter
rows gain the keys and hint areas (a two-row grid), .is-needs, the kbd chip rules and the prefix chips in the group label and the foot; the prompt state of the tools row

rewritten for the deck: the five groups of SPEC 6.3 built from the document, the block and slide kind catalogs, the action table and the version log; the prefix parser and the scored fuzzy filter are new
